background_setting: A rural-to-suburban two-lane asphalt road stretching toward a railroad crossing under a flat, overcast sky. Gravel shoulders line the road, with scattered utility poles, sparse leafless trees, and low grassy embankments on either side. The railroad tracks run left to right across the road ahead, flanked by signal posts, crossbuck signs, and warning light assemblies. A freight train is visible entering the crossing from the right. The muted daylight gives everything a soft, diffused, slightly desaturated appearance.

lighting.direction: Diffuse, top-down ambient light with no strong directional source
lighting.shadows: Soft, faint shadows beneath the gate, vehicles, and posts
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, low-contrast illumination that flattens colors and softens edges, making the flashing red crossing lights stand out vividly

aesthetics.composition: Centered first-person driving composition with the road leading to a vanishing point at the crossing; the lowered gate and flashing signals anchor the midground, the train crossing on the right
aesthetics.color_scheme: Muted grays and desaturated greens and browns dominate, punctuated by the vivid red and white of the crossing gate and pulsing red warning lights
aesthetics.patterns: Diagonal red-and-white stripes on the gate arm; repeating railroad ties and lane markings

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.focus: The crossing gate, flashing lights, and approaching train in sharp focus

context: Autonomous driving / ADAS perception scenario demonstrating recognition of an active railroad crossing and a safe complete stop

actions.description: The ego vehicle drives forward along the two-lane road, approaching the railroad crossing as the lowered gate and flashing red lights come into clearer view.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The vehicle comes to a complete stop behind the gate and remains fully stationary while the lights flash and the train crosses; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: White crossbuck sign with bold black lettering, weathered
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Mounted on the signal post left of the gate, visible throughout

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: White rectangular sign with black text
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Roadside near the crossing, visible in the midground
text_and_signage_elements.context: Instructs drivers where to stop when the signal is active

segments.description: The ego car travels forward toward the railroad crossing under overcast light, the lowered red-and-white gate and flashing lights ahead, a freight train approaching from the right.
segments.key_changes: Crossing details become larger and clearer as the vehicle advances.
segments.camera: Forward tracking motion at moderate speed

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
segments.key_changes: Speed falls steadily from moderate to exactly zero across two full seconds; the forward motion of the scene slows visibly frame by frame until it ceases entirely at 0:03.5
segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: The vehicle is fully stopped behind the lowered gate and remains stationary as the freight train crosses and the red lights continue to flash. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle drives forward along the two-lane road, approaching the railroad crossing as the lowered gate and flashing red lights come into clearer view. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient road and tire noise fades as the vehicle decelerates. The rhythmic clang of the crossing bell and the low rumble and rhythmic clatter of the approaching freight train dominate, accompanied by the periodic hum of the flashing signal and a faint diesel drone. No speech or music.
